controls_and_limitations.scope: Live Azure Service Bus / Blob provider
controls_and_limitations.details: Hermetic native tests do not measure broker retry timing, physical shared connection interruption, service lock renewal, cloud checkpoint access, restart durability or Embedded/Standard resource costs.

New probe tests use DNS-style HTTPS with explicit port; no new native path-style emulator probe control. Existing ServiceBus default/custom/emulator endpoint tests are separate positive controls. BlobUriBuilder uses SDK endpoint parsing; no observed emulator regression.

controls_and_limitations.scope: Factory creation/stop races and construction failures
controls_and_limitations.details: The added tests do not directly fault each SDK constructor or race creation against terminal stop. Unchanged generic owner chain was reviewed; administration-first construction reduces partial messaging allocation. No empirically confirmed survivor claimed.
This patch verdict does not close other findings, all inherited/public/XML surfaces, full native provider profiles, pack/package-consumer gates or external release chain.
